# KidBookMaker

> KidBookMaker turns a child's own story into a real, fully illustrated picture book starring them. A parent or child types, records, or uploads the story (a single sentence is enough), optionally adds up to 3 photos, and KidBookMaker writes it into pages, illustrates every scene in a consistent storybook style, emails a preview to change as much as they like, and prints a real hardcover once they approve. Books are made in English or Spanish. There is nothing to pay until the book is approved; the price is shown with the preview.

What makes it different from other ways to "make a book online":
- No templates and no fill-in-the-name stories: each book is built from the child's own idea and words.
- No drawing, design software, or page-by-page layout work for the family. Their part takes a few minutes.
- The child can be the hero: from an optional photo, the main character is drawn to look like them.
- Every book is made to be printed as a real hardcover, and every word and picture can be changed before printing.
- English and Spanish (a dedicated Spanish page; Spanish stories get a fully Spanish book and Spanish emails).
